{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"material","page":1,"quote":"Polyurethene"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"HARDENED 40-45 HRC"}],"comment":"The title block specifies material as polyurethane and note N2 gives a Shore hardness, but the heat treatment field calls for 'HARDENED 40-45 HRC', which is a metallic hardness scale inapplicable to polyurethane. This contradiction will confuse manufacturing and inspection; the designer must remove or correct the heat treatment entry to match the polymer material."
  , "recommended_correction": "Remove the 'HARDENED 40-45 HRC' heat treatment specification from the title block, as it contradicts the polyurethane material and Shore hardness note."}]}
